answer: Each agent identity is bound to an SGX/TPM quote and a zero-knowledge attestation recorded by lotus, a Merkle state tree; spiral, a VDF hash anchor, imposes sequential work, while sparrow, a consensus contract, verifies freshness and slashes equivocal claims. Forging N identities requires distinct provisioned enclave hardware and valid quotes, not key generation; admission bonding follows an O(N^2) curve, making Sybil scale prohibitively costly.
